Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the Terminate Employment section names; the revoke access, rehire, and payroll eligibility field labels; whether the seniority dates screen still appears; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Use this when a position is eliminated. RIFs carry a 60-day notification period, and the separation agreement decides how the last working day is entered.

Use this whenA position is eliminated.

HCM Academy job aid · Offboarding

Reduction in force (RIF)

Use when: A position is eliminated. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Terminate Employment for the employee.
  2. Notification date: the day they were notified.
  3. Termination date: the end of the 60-day notice.
  4. Action: Involuntary termination. Reason: Reduction in force.
  5. Click Continue, then set revoke access.
  6. Leave payroll eligibility as defaulted.
  7. Last working day, by scenario.
    • Non-working notice (paid, no work, equipment returned now): last working day = notification date.
    • Working notice (finishing projects): leave blank, or enter the last day of the notice period.
  8. Click Submit.

Watch-outs

  • The separation agreement sets which scenario applies. Confirm before entering.
  • Most RIFs are non-working notice.
